common.implementation: Actual React JSX composition of the existing actual React Checkbox01/Switch01 shared core. Each of19 native inputs owns its own React scalar lifecycle. No DOM mount adapter, iframe, innerHTML, network, storage or executed upstream dependency.
common.ownership: checked!==undefined owns the Boolean model; runtime null is controlled false. undefined releases last effective model. defaultChecked is mount-only reset baseline, including explicit false. ownerRevision is an explicit command even on same values. Committed value/ownership/revision or safety change wins over older proposal and reset work. Plain same-value metadata renders are not owner commands.
common.events: Member onClick and native input-target click listeners may veto before proposal. onChange receives the original React event even for canceled activation. Member onChange then group onChange unless synthetic/native defaultPrevented, then onCheckedChange proposal. Return values are ignored. preventDefault in onCheckedChange is too late to veto. onChange/Click/proposal exceptions propagate, no failed proposal commits, and current model redraws. Ordinary event observers can finish after synchronous unmount, but scalar proposal cannot commit after it.
common.synchronousOwner: flushSync/committed parent acceptance, same-value ownerRevision command, control takeover then release, disabled/readOnly, keyed replacement or unmount supersedes older callback work. Batched state requests take effect when committed; no claim that an uncommitted render already owns the field.
common.reset: Native form.reset default actions, cancellation during reset dispatch, controlled owner state, mount baseline, multiple valid/canceled resets, same-model post-return click, dispatch-time edit, committed owner/revision changes, replacement and unmount use shared scalar observer. Reset is silent, not a proposal. Current native el.form determines association. Form transfer retires old reset. Newly mounted scalar fields can join an active same-family reset.
common.resetLimits: Late preventDefault after dispatch, earlier stopImmediatePropagation blocking the observer, or direct property changes without native editing events are outside guarantee. Canceled click listeners later than React processing cannot retroactively retract an emitted proposal.
common.groupAPI: Exactly the declared source member slots, each BooleanFieldProps|null and matching keyRef. Group ref is div. No aggregate checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange/value/defaultValue/values/defaultValues/onValueChange/name API; runtime ignored. Group disabled/readOnly OR member safety; member false cannot bypass. form defaults to group and member explicit form (including empty string) wins. ownerRevision is combined without collapsing undefined/-0.
common.forms: Each member supports native name/value/required/form/ref. Unchecked/disabled omitted from FormData; readOnly checked remains successful. Same names permit repeated successful values. Group does not synthesize hidden aggregate inputs.
common.accessibility: Stable native inputs with useId-prefix ids, labels/help/errors associated, role=switch on switch inputs, group heading/description/error associations. Native checkbox Space handled by browser; Enter extension for switches respects veto/repeat/modifiers/composition/safety. Group source no-label controls receive translated aria-label. A supplied visible member label becomes the native accessible name unless the caller explicitly supplies aria-label; source-only aria-label is added only when no visible label exists.
common.visualScope: Source shape/cardinality/state differences preserved with Follow semantic token adaptation; other six themes are portability fixtures, not six additional849 completion claims. Static14-mode color checks distinguish external text/surface/focus from fixed-white active icon. 44px hit targets explicitly differ from source visual-only dimensions.
common.acceptance: Candidate only; no formal accepted IDs and no Flutter/native credit.
